name: Year in Review (Wrapped)
description: A Spotify-Wrapped-style year-in-review for a loan originator, by NMLS ID. Server-rendered so the API key never reaches the browser.

variables.label: Model Match API key
variables.help: Create one in the Model Match dashboard. Sent as the x-api-key header, server-side only — it is never exposed to the browser.

variables.label: Originator NMLS ID to feature
variables.help: The loan originator whose year gets wrapped (e.g. 1036297).
